subject: Mental Models
title: Reinforcing Loops
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Reinforcing Loops.

hook.text: A popular song gets more streams. More streams push it higher on charts. Higher charts bring more listeners.

buildup.text: A reinforcing feedback loop amplifies change. Growth feeds more growth. Decline feeds more decline.

discovery.text: Compound interest is a reinforcing loop. Viral marketing is one too.

twist.text: Reinforcing loops sound great when going up. But when going down, they are equally powerful and devastatingly fast.

climax.text: Identify reinforcing loops early. Accelerate the virtuous ones. Interrupt the vicious ones before they gain momentum.

punchline.text: Loops amplify direction. Good loops lift you. Bad loops crush you.

quiz.question: What defines a reinforcing feedback loop?
options: It stabilizes the system at a fixed point
It amplifies change in the same direction, creating growth or decline spirals
It only works in positive directions
